#WalangPasok: Manila City Mayor Francisco “Isko” Moreno Domagoso has suspended face-to-face classes in all public and private schools on November 17 and 18 to give way to the peaceful rally of the Iglesia ni Cristo at the Quirino Grandstand in Luneta.

Schools are advised to shift to Alternative Delivery Mode (ADM) during the two-day suspension. | @dMorcosoINQ

data.text:
FULL ROAD CLOSURE SA KAMUNING BUS STATION 

Isasara pansamantala ang Kamuning Busway Station para bigyang-daan ang konstruksyon ng Kamuning Footbridge.

Hindi titigil ang EDSA Busway bus sa Kamuning Station at dadaan ito sa alternatibong ruta sa sumusunod na mga araw: 

• Northbound: 15–17 November 2025 (1:00 AM to 4:00 AM)
• Southbound: 11–15 December 2025 (1:00 AM to 4:00 AM)

Maaring sumakay o bumaba ang mga pasahero sa Quezon Avenue or Nepa Q-Mart.

📷: Department of Transportation/Facebook
